source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 229 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-229.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 229 was established by Ordinance No. 19068, passed by the Dallas City Council on March 19, 1986. Ordinance No. 19068 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 19068 was amended by Ordinance No. 24122, passed by the Dallas City Council on December 8, 1999. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19068; 24122; 25711)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-229.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 229 is established on property generally located at the east corner of Welborn Street and Cedar Springs Road. The size of PD 229 is approximately 2.089 acres. (Ord. Nos. 19068; 25711)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-229.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25711)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-229.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Utilization of the Property must be in accordance with the city plan commission-approved development plan (Exhibit 229A). (Ord. Nos. 24122; 25711)

sections.title: Landscape Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-229.105. LANDSCAPE PLAN.

Landscaping must be installed as shown on the city plan commission-approved landscape plan (Exhibit 229B) prior to the issuance of any certificate of occupancy. All plant material must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 24122; 25711)

sections.title: Parkway Landscape Permit
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-229.106. PARKWAY LANDSCAPE PERMIT.

A parkway landscape permit must be obtained from the department of public works and transportation prior to the installation of any landscaping within the right-of-way of either Cedar Springs Road or Welborn Avenue. (Ord. Nos. 24122; 25711)

sections.title: Uses
Floor Area Limitations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-229.108. FLOOR AREA LIMITATIONS.

(a) Maximum permitted total floor area for all uses on the Property combined is 409,650 square feet. Additionally, the following restrictions apply.

(b) Maximum permitted total floor area for the office uses described in Section 51P- 229.107(3) is 270,000 square feet.

(c) Maximum permitted total floor area for the retail and restaurant uses described in Sections 51P-229.107(4) and (5) combined is 60,000 square feet.

(1) Retail use limitations. Maximum permitted total floor area for the retail uses described in Section 51P-229.107(4) is 60,000 square feet. Of this 60,000 square feet, 20,000 square feet is limited to individual uses with floor areas of no more than 2,500 square feet. No single retail use is permitted to have a floor area that exceeds 8,000 square feet.

(2) Restaurant use limitations. Maximum permitted total floor area for the restaurant uses described in Section 51P-229.107(5) is 20,000 square feet. Of this 20,000 square feet, 12,000 square feet is limited to individual uses with a floor area of no more than 2,500 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 24122; 25711)

sections.title: Floor Area Definition
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-229.109. FLOOR AREA DEFINITION.

For the purpose of this article, floor area includes only air conditioned floor area. (Ord. Nos. 24122; 25711)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-229.110. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) Off-street parking. Off-street parking for a multiple-family use is one space for each 500 square feet of floor area, with a minimum of one space and a maximum of two spaces required for each dwelling unit. All other uses must comply with the parking provisions of PD 193, the Oak Lawn Special Purpose District contained in Article 193.

(b) Off-street loading. Off-street loading must be provided as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 24122; 25711)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-229.111. SETBACKS.

Setbacks must be provided as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 24122; 25711)

sections.title: Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-229.112. HEIGHT.

Maximum permitted height of any structure on the Property is 240 feet. (Ord. Nos. 24122; 25711)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-229.113. SIGNS.

Except as provided below, all signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Division 51-7.400. Premise signs on Cedar Springs Road and Welborn Street, for those retail and restaurant uses that have a floor area of no more than 2,500 square feet, are limited to an effective area of 10 square feet per premise. (Ord. Nos. 24122; 25711)

sections.title: Oak Lawn Special Purpose District
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-229.114. OAK LAWN SPECIAL PURPOSE DISTRICT.

Unless specifically altered by this article or the development and landscape plans, the development of the Property must comply with the provisions of the O-2 Office Subdistrict in PD 193. (Ord. Nos. 24122; 25711)

sections.title: Certificate Of Occupancy
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-229.115. CERTIFICATE OF OCCUPANCY.

No certificate of occupancy may be issued for any retail, restaurant, or office use until certificates of occupancy have been issued for multiple-family uses which have a minimum total floor area of 91,033 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 24122; 25711)

sections.title: Exterior Design Of Structures
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-229.116. EXTERIOR DESIGN OF STRUCTURES.

Highly reflective facade materials, as defined in Ordinance No. 21859, are prohibited. (Ord. Nos. 24122; 25711)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-229.117. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) Development of this Property must comply with all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(c) The building official shall not issue a building permit or a certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this ordinance, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 24122; 25711)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-229.118. ZONING MAP.

PD 229 is located on Zoning Map No. I-7. (Ord. Nos. 19068; 25711)
